experiment.hypothesis: ETH-USD hourly prices exhibit mean reversion to a 24-hour moving average with a 3% threshold, as evidenced by statistically significant error metrics (R-squared > 0.35, RMSE < 10% of SMA range, Sharpe ratio > 0.5) in backtested data.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If the R-squared of the hourly mean reversion model is below 0.35, or if the RMSE exceeds 10% of the 24-hour SMA range, or if the Sharpe ratio falls below 0.5 over a 30-day rolling window, the hypothesis is falsified.
